craptech_limotv_power.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.power() end
craptech_limotv_power.title: TV: on / off
craptech_limotv_power.desc: The limo bar's TV: on or off (its round POWER button)

craptech_limotv_next.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.nextChannel() end
craptech_limotv_next.title: TV: next channel
craptech_limotv_next.desc: The limo bar's TV: next channel, switching it on if it is off (CH up, or the screen)

craptech_limotv_prev.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.prevChannel() end
craptech_limotv_prev.title: TV: previous channel
craptech_limotv_prev.desc: The limo bar's TV: previous channel, switching it on if it is off (CH down)

craptech_limotv_disp.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.display() end
craptech_limotv_disp.title: TV: show the channel
craptech_limotv_disp.desc: The limo bar's TV: shows the channel number a few seconds (DISP)

craptech_limotv_volup.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.volumeUp() end
craptech_limotv_volup.title: TV: volume up
craptech_limotv_volup.desc: The limo bar's TV: louder (VL up)

craptech_limotv_voldown.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechLimoTV') if c then c.volumeDown() end
craptech_limotv_voldown.title: TV: volume down
craptech_limotv_voldown.desc: The limo bar's TV: quieter (VL down)
